validity: All 60 frozen query-engine cells must be valid; otherwise remain unranked
baseline: Best complete R16, 9/60, composite 31.86111; reused historical control, not fresh/simultaneous. Keep requires strictly more than 9/60.
current_production: R16 unchanged, 9/60, keep; exact best observed seed
